items: New manual chapter "Tool reference": all 388 UEFN MCP tools by toolset, with the parameters of their tested recipe, whether they write, and how far the recipe is proven. It is generated by `tool/build_tool_reference.py`, so it stays in step with the recipes. Epic's own descriptions are not in it: they stay on your computer, `mcp_map.py --find` shows them.
A recipe can be `avoid`: a known trap (the static-mesh `get_lod_count` crashes the editor) is documented, never replayed and left out of the totals, like the multi-step notes.
Recipes: final notes for the three that still fail (ApplyStackIssueFix, GetClientLogEntries, SelectAssets). State: 387 proven, 4 unverified, 3 failed.
release.title: v1.107.3 — A manual with every tool, and a status for known traps
